notes: If your pinned artists vanished, SideCut now restores them from the on-device backup copy that is written right after every change — once, so a deliberate unpin-all stays unpinned. The restored pins are saved back to the library immediately.

While storage is being re-read after a crash, the pinned strip now says your artists are still on this phone and keeps retrying — it no longer paints the empty "add some artists" placeholder over data that was never deleted.

Downloads got stricter about the actual audio: the fallback source must pass the same song-title check as verified sources, and a clip 15–60 seconds off the real length is only used when the video title exactly matches the track — the last two ways a same-artist different song could land with the right tags.
